Function: Used to check the configuration after generation
Author: Nguyen Hung Quan and Claude (user)

Table - Register Definition.Description: AES-GCM accelerator version register. Reports the IP major and minor version numbers.

Bits.Description:
Major version number of the AES-GCM accelerator. Software reads it to select a compatible driver.

Usage: Read after reset; software never writes this field.

Values:
0x1 major version 1 (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Minor version number of the AES-GCM accelerator. Software reads it to detect compatible additions.

Usage: Read after reset; software never writes this field.

Values:
0x0 minor version 0 (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Table - Register Definition.Description: AES-GCM capability register. Reports the elaboration parameters of this instance.

Bits.Description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Number of AES block lanes of the AES core. Reads the value of PARA_AES_LANE_NUM.

Usage: Read to size driver buffers and throughput expectations.

Values:
0x1 to 0x4 lanes (reset value 0x1).

Unit: lanes.

Limits: 0x1 to 0x4.

This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Number of internal context slots. Reads the value of PARA_GCM_CTX_NUM.

Usage: Read before using suspend and resume.

Values:
0x0 to 0x4 number of slots (reset value 0x0).

Unit: slots.

Limits: 0x0 to 0x4.

This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Context export flag. Reads the value of PARA_GCM_CTX_MODE.

Usage: Read before using the aesgcm_ctxx registers.

Values:
0x0 internal context slots (reset value);
0x1 context export through registers.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Asynchronous clock domain flag. Reads the value of PARA_CLK_ASYNC.

Usage: Read to learn the crossing structure that the instance uses.

Values:
0x0 synchronous related clocks (reset value);
0x1 asynchronous clocks.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Key side-load supported flag. Reads 1 when PARA_KEY_SIDE_EN equals 1.

Usage: Read before selecting aesgcm_cfg.key_src equal to 1.

Values:
0x0 side-load not built (reset value);
0x1 side-load built.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

AXI4 data window present flag. Reads 1 for the wrapper m_aesgcm_acc_axi_top.

Usage: Read before selecting aesgcm_cfg.dat_src equal to 0.

Values:
0x0 no AXI4 window (reset value);
0x1 AXI4 window present.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

GCM supported flag. Reads 1 when the instance was built with PARA_AES_GCM_EN equal to 1.

Usage: Read before selecting mode 5 in aesgcm_cfg.mode; the status reflects the build, not a run-time state.

Values:
0x0 GCM not built (reset value);
0x1 GCM built.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Table - Register Definition.Description: AES-GCM control register. Enables the accelerator and issues commands to the message sequencer.

Bits.Description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Accelerator enable. Software sets it to allow messages; clearing it while idle holds the sequencer in idle.

Usage: Set once after reset before the first start; clear to block new messages. Do not clear while aesgcm_sts.busy is 1.

Values:
0x0 disabled (reset value);
0x1 enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Free context slot command. Software sets it to clear the context slot selected by aesgcm_cfg.ctx_id.

Usage: Write 1 while the accelerator is idle; hardware clears it when the slot is cleared.

Values:
0x0 no free (reset value);
0x1 free requested.

Unit: none.

Limits: Requires PARA_GCM_CTX_NUM greater than 0.

New key declaration. Software sets it after loading a new key to latch the tag length of that key and to invalidate any verified context.

Usage: Write 1 after the last write to the aesgcm_key registers (or after the side-loaded key changes) and before the first start with that key; hardware clears it when the tag length is latched.

Values:
0x0 no new key (reset value);
0x1 new key declared.

Unit: none.

Limits: A different aesgcm_cfg.tag_len before the next key_new raises the configuration error event.

Resume message command. Software sets it to restore the context of slot aesgcm_cfg.ctx_id and continue its message.

Usage: Write 1 while aesgcm_sts.busy is 0 and the selected slot is valid in aesgcm_sts.ctx_vld; hardware clears it when the context is restored.

Values:
0x0 no resume (reset value);
0x1 resume requested.

Unit: none.

Limits: Requires PARA_GCM_CTX_NUM greater than 0.

Suspend message command. Software sets it to stop the active GCM message at a block boundary and save its context in the slot selected by aesgcm_cfg.ctx_id.

Usage: Write 1 while aesgcm_sts.busy is 1 and the message is in the AAD or payload phase; hardware clears it when the context is saved.

Values:
0x0 no suspend (reset value);
0x1 suspend requested.

Unit: none.

Limits: Requires PARA_GCM_CTX_NUM greater than 0.

Zeroize command. Software sets it to clear every key store, context slot, intermediate GCM value and the AES core; hardware clears it when the clear is complete.

Usage: Write 1 after every message that must not leave key material behind, and after a reset of only one clock domain. Completion is reported by aesgcm_sts.zeroized.

Values:
0x0 no zeroize (reset value);
0x1 zeroize requested.

Unit: none.

Limits: Completes within 64 core clocks.

Abort message command. Software sets it to stop the active message; hardware clears it when the sequencer has returned to idle.

Usage: Write 1 at any time; abort has priority over start in the same access. The input FIFO and output FIFO are flushed and key stores stay loaded.

Values:
0x0 no abort (reset value);
0x1 abort requested.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Start message command. Software sets it to start the message described by the configuration registers; hardware clears it when the configuration bundle is accepted by the core domain.

Usage: Write 1 after aesgcm_en is 1 and all configuration registers are programmed; do not rewrite while it reads 1. Hardware clears it, or software reads 0 as the accepted indication.

Values:
0x0 no start (reset value);
0x1 start requested.

Unit: none.

Limits: Write only while aesgcm_sts.busy is 0.

Table - Register Definition.Description: AES-GCM configuration register. Selects mode, direction, key source, data path and per-message options.

Bits.Description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Context slot identifier. Selects the slot used by suspend, resume and free.

Usage: Program before writing aesgcm_ctrl.suspend, resume or free.

Values:
0x0 to 0x3 slot number (reset value 0x0).

Unit: none.

Limits: Value must be below aesgcm_cap.ctx_num.

Data path. Selects the AXI4 data window or the APB programmed-I/O registers for the next message.

Usage: Program before start; 0x0 requires aesgcm_cap.axi_en equal to 1.

Values:
0x0 AXI4 window (reset value);
0x1 APB programmed I/O.

Unit: none.

Limits: 0x0 on the APB wrapper raises the configuration error event.

Key source. Selects the aesgcm_key registers or the key side-load port.

Usage: Program before start; 0x1 requires aesgcm_cap.key_side equal to 1.

Values:
0x0 aesgcm_key registers (reset value);
0x1 side-load port.

Unit: none.

Limits: 0x1 with no side-load raises the key error event.

Key size. Selects AES-128 or AES-256 for a key written by software; ignored for a side-loaded key whose size comes from the key manager.

Usage: Program before start; with aesgcm_cfg.key_src equal to 0 the first 4 (AES-128) or 8 (AES-256) aesgcm_key registers are used.

Values:
0x0 AES-128 (reset value);
0x1 AES-256.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Direction. Selects encryption or decryption for the next message.

Usage: Program before start; for GCM it selects authenticated encryption or authenticated decryption.

Values:
0x0 encrypt (reset value);
0x1 decrypt.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Table - Register Definition.Description: AES-GCM additional authenticated data length register. Holds the AAD length of the next message.

Bits.Description:
AAD length in bytes. Number of AAD bytes of the next GCM message at the start of the input stream.

Usage: Program before start; use 0 for legacy modes and for policy A pass 2.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF byte count (reset value 0x0).

Unit: byte.

Limits: 0x0 to 0xFFFFFFFF.

Table - Register Definition.Description: AES-GCM payload length register. Holds the payload length of the next message.

Bits.Description:
Payload length in bytes. Number of plaintext or ciphertext bytes of the next message.

Usage: Program before start; 0 gives GMAC in GCM mode.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF byte count (reset value 0x0).

Unit: byte.

Limits: 0x0 to 0xFFFFFFFF; CBC, ECB multiples of 16 for legacy modes.

Table - Register Definition.Description: AES-GCM key wait register. Holds the side-load time-out of the sequencer.

Bits.Description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Side-load wait time in core clocks. Time that the sequencer waits for i_key_side_valid before it raises the key error event.

Usage: Program before start when aesgcm_cfg.key_src equals 1.

Values:
0x0001 to 0xFFFF clocks (reset value 0x100).

Unit: core clock.

Limits: 0x0001 to 0xFFFF; 0x0 means no wait.

Table - Register Definition.Description: AES-GCM key word register. Write-only key word, four bytes of the key.

Bits.Description:
Key word. Four key bytes with byte 4k in bits [7:0]; reads return zero and the hardware clears it on zeroize.

Usage: Write words 0 to 3 for AES-128 or 0 to 7 for AES-256 before start and then write aesgcm_ctrl.key_new; software cannot read the key back.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF key word (reset value 0x0).

Unit: none.

Limits: Only used when aesgcm_cfg.key_src equals 0.

Table - Register Definition.Description: AES-GCM status register. Reports sequencer state and message results.

Bits.Description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Context slot valid mask. Bit i is 1 while slot i holds a suspended context.

Usage: Read before resume.

Values:
0x0 no slot valid (reset value);
0x1 to 0xF valid slots mask.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Key store valid flag. Reads 1 while the core domain holds a key.

Usage: Check before start with a key written earlier.

Values:
0x0 no key (reset value);
0x1 key held.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Secure-only flag. Reads the resynchronized value of the pin i_gcm_secure_only.

Usage: Read to know whether policy C and context export are blocked.

Values:
0x0 policy C allowed;
0x1 policy A forced (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Zeroize complete flag. Reads 1 after aesgcm_ctrl.zeroize completed, until the next start.

Usage: Poll after writing aesgcm_ctrl.zeroize.

Values:
0x0 not zeroized (reset value);
0x1 zeroize complete.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Verified-context flag of policy A. Reads 1 after pass 1 matched and until the next start, key_new or zeroize.

Usage: Check before starting pass 2.

Values:
0x0 no verified context (reset value);
0x1 context verified.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Tag comparison result of the last decryption message or pass.

Usage: Read after the DONE event; valid until the next start.

Values:
0x0 tag mismatch or not compared (reset value);
0x1 tag matched.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Message active flag. Reads 1 from start acceptance until the message ends or is suspended.

Usage: Poll before changing configuration registers.

Values:
0x0 idle (reset value);
0x1 message active.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

0x1 empty (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Values:
0x0 room available (reset value);
0x1 full.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Table - Register Definition.Description: AES-GCM raw interrupt register. Holds the sticky event causes.

Bits.Description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

PROTO_ERR raw event. Protocol misuse. Hardware sets it, software clears it by writing 1.

Usage: Write 1 to clear after servicing; hardware sets it again for a new event; a set and a clear in the same cycle keep the event.

Values:
0x0 inactive (reset value);
0x1 active.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

KEY_ERR raw event. Key source error. Hardware sets it, software clears it by writing 1.

Usage: Write 1 to clear after servicing; hardware sets it again for a new event; a set and a clear in the same cycle keep the event.

Values:
0x0 inactive (reset value);
0x1 active.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

CTX_SWITCH_DONE raw event. Suspend or resume finished. Hardware sets it, software clears it by writing 1.

Usage: Write 1 to clear after servicing; hardware sets it again for a new event; a set and a clear in the same cycle keep the event.

Values:
0x0 inactive (reset value);
0x1 active.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

DMA_OUT_RDY raw event. Output FIFO holds a burst. Hardware sets it, software clears it by writing 1.

Usage: Write 1 to clear after servicing; hardware sets it again for a new event; a set and a clear in the same cycle keep the event.

Values:
0x0 inactive (reset value);
0x1 active.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

DMA_IN_RDY raw event. Input FIFO has room for a burst. Hardware sets it, software clears it by writing 1.

Usage: Write 1 to clear after servicing; hardware sets it again for a new event; a set and a clear in the same cycle keep the event.

Values:
0x0 inactive (reset value);
0x1 active.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

CTR_EXHAUST raw event. AES core counter error. Hardware sets it, software clears it by writing 1.

Usage: Write 1 to clear after servicing; hardware sets it again for a new event; a set and a clear in the same cycle keep the event.

Values:
0x0 inactive (reset value);
0x1 active.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

LEN_ERR raw event. Length error. Hardware sets it, software clears it by writing 1.

Usage: Write 1 to clear after servicing; hardware sets it again for a new event; a set and a clear in the same cycle keep the event.

Values:
0x0 inactive (reset value);
0x1 active.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

CFG_ERR raw event. Illegal configuration at start. Hardware sets it, software clears it by writing 1.

Usage: Write 1 to clear after servicing; hardware sets it again for a new event; a set and a clear in the same cycle keep the event.

Values:
0x0 inactive (reset value);
0x1 active.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Usage: Write 1 to clear after servicing; hardware sets it again for a new event; a set and a clear in the same cycle keep the event.

Values:
0x0 inactive (reset value);
0x1 active.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

DONE raw event. Message or pass finished. Hardware sets it, software clears it by writing 1.

Usage: Write 1 to clear after servicing; hardware sets it again for a new event; a set and a clear in the same cycle keep the event.

Values:
0x0 inactive (reset value);
0x1 active.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Table - Register Definition.Description: AES-GCM error code register. Holds the first error of the last message.

Bits.Description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

AES core error code. Error code that the AES core reported when code equals 0x7.

Usage: Read together with code; codes follow the AES core specification.

Values:
0x0 none (reset value);
0x1 to 0x5 core codes 1 to 5;
0x6 to 0xF reserved.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Table - Register Definition.Description: AES-GCM failed authentication counter register. Counts failed tag comparisons.

Bits.Description:
Failed tag counter. Number of failed tag comparisons since reset, saturating at its maximum.

Usage: Read to detect repeated forgery attempts; only a hardware reset clears it.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF count (reset value 0x0).

Unit: count.

Limits: Saturates at 0xFFFFFFFF.

Table - Register Definition.Description: AES-GCM DMA configuration register. Enables the DMA channels and sets burst sizes.

Bits.Description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

Output DMA channel enable. Allows o_dma_out_req to rise.

Usage: Set before start when a DMA controller drains the output stream.

Values:
0x0 disabled (reset value);
0x1 enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Input DMA channel enable. Allows o_dma_in_req to rise.

Usage: Set before start when a DMA controller feeds the input stream.

Values:
0x0 disabled (reset value);
0x1 enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Table - Register Definition.Description: AES-GCM programmed-I/O input register. Pushes one 32-bit stream word.

Bits.Description:
Input stream word. Four stream bytes with the first byte at bits [7:0]; each write pushes one word into the input FIFO.

Usage: Write after checking aesgcm_fifosts.in_full; a write to a full FIFO is dropped and raises the protocol error event.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF stream word (reset value 0x0).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Table - Register Definition.Description: AES-GCM programmed-I/O output register. Pops one 32-bit stream word.

Bits.Description:
Output stream word. Next four output bytes with the first byte at bits [7:0]; each read pops one word from the output FIFO.

Usage: Read after checking aesgcm_fifosts.out_empty; a read from an empty FIFO returns zero and raises the protocol error event.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF stream word (reset value 0x0).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Table - Register Definition.Description: AES-GCM consumed AAD bytes register. Reports AAD bytes consumed at the last suspend.

Bits.Description:
Consumed AAD bytes. Number of AAD bytes absorbed by the suspended message.

Usage: Read after the CTX_SWITCH_DONE event of a suspend to resend the remaining AAD.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF byte count (reset value 0x0).

Unit: byte.

Limits: none.

Table - Register Definition.Description: AES-GCM consumed payload bytes register. Reports payload bytes consumed at the last suspend.

Bits.Description:
Consumed payload bytes. Number of payload bytes processed by the suspended message.

Usage: Read after the CTX_SWITCH_DONE event of a suspend to resend the remaining ciphertext or plaintext.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF byte count (reset value 0x0).

Unit: byte.

Limits: none.

Table - Register Definition.Description: AES-GCM context export word register. Window for exporting and importing a suspended context.

Bits.Description:
Context word. Reads return the exported context word and writes load an imported word; available only when PARA_GCM_CTX_MODE equals 1.

Usage: Read all 24 words after a suspend to save the context; write all 24 words before resume to restore it; blocked while the pin i_gcm_secure_only is 1.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF context word (reset value 0x0).

Unit: none.

Limits: Words are valid only between suspend and resume.
